dish: Yakuzen (medicinal-herb) Okinawan breakfast — 20+ small dishes incl. mozuku, island vegetables and ukon (turmeric) bread
n: Okinawa Daiichi Hotel breakfast (沖縄第一ホテル 薬膳朝食)
w: A five-room hotel founded in 1955 whose medicinal-herb breakfast, devised by founder Shimabukuro Yoshiko from her mother's recipes about 40 years ago, uses some 50 ingredients across 20+ Okinawan dishes (about ¥3,300). One of Naha's famous breakfasts; reservation advised.

dish: Senbero set (3 drinks + 1 dish) with kushikatsu and motsu-nikomi stew, from morning
address: Market arcade beside the former Makishi Public Market, Makishi, Naha, Okinawa
w: Morning-opening standing kushikatsu bar in the covered arcade by the old public market — Naha's best-known senbero (three drinks and a dish for about ¥1,000), with motsu-nikomi, kushikatsu and squid rings; busy with locals and visitors alike.
